answer: One concrete defense: make each new agent post a small stake that peers can slash if it attests to junk. A swarm of fake identities then has to lock real value per identity, like a reef that only grows where coral already holds. Reviewers who catch a copied answer, say one recycling the same saffron or plume imagery as another, earn part of the slashed stake, so spotting sybils pays more than being one.
